meta.IndexSource: Yahoo Finance KOSPI ^KS11 / KOSDAQ ^KQ11 daily close
meta.MissingIndexPolicy: block new entries only; continue exits on available stock data
meta.Limitations: Yahoo index not independently reconciled to KRX; reconstructed adjusted OHLC; fractional shares; no explicit delisting recovery model; daily bars use stop-first before TP; runner starts after TP day; historical tax schedule is inherited model, not a tax audit; commission 0.015% and slippage 0.10% each side, not 0.8% round trip
meta.YearlyTradeAttribution: exit year; return is equity calendar-year return

summary.CostModel: commission 0.015% each side + slippage 0.10% each side + historical KOSPI/KOSDAQ sell tax
summary.SignalPriority: RS desc, volume ratio desc, code asc
summary.Entry: signal-day adjusted close with +0.10% buy slippage
summary.Exit: -8% before TP; +24% sell 1/3 original quantity; remaining 2/3 prior MA20 intraday touch; gap at open
summary.MarketFilter: KOSPI/KOSDAQ official price index close >= own SMA120
